body: Somewhere in here ... add a "Words of Caution" Section. Rember don't blindly update these settings. . if you are great at immedately replying to cladue and are patiantely awaying each and every claude question / and your main session never holds / waits for more than 5 minutes, a 5 mintue ttl will save you the most ... Also, if you live life on the edge and auto approve everthing / bypass all permisions check, a 5 mintute ttl is liekly best for your too ... its only if your main session constantly awaits feedback from you, or your main session holds and waits on sub agents that take more than 5 minutes should you consider the 1 hour ttl caceh. Also add another seciton ... Changing Your Habits to Optimize Cache (maybe this is a seperate blog post all together - the cheapes is to never take a break for 5+ miutes / minmzue those and use 5 min cache. Next is to do the same with 1 hour cahce. Another is to limit sub agetns to not operate for longer than 1 horu if main session goign to hold for thme, etc
